name: mdor bsdus thal 'gyur 'phreng
item_description:
Script: dpe tshugs.
Two sets of folio numbers, from 1 to 10 and from 530 to 539.
Orthography:
- Bindu for m
- Particle pa/ba takes the form ba after final –n (e.g., yin ba)
- Abbreviations – word written together with following particle (e.g., skabs_su, thal_lo); inverted d for final -ng 
A few corrections in dbu can.
